title: Growing the shop in the right order
target: How to spend on growth in Supermarket Simulator when the shop level, the upgrades and the storage each move on a track of their own.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A shop trading well enough to spend on
Some stock already in the back room
An idea of what is actually limiting you today

steps.do: Work out whether the limit is shelf space or back-room space before buying anything.
steps.because: storage has an upgrade level of its own, separate from the shop's (storageUpgradeLevel)

steps.do: Buy storage when you are turning stock away, not when a shelf is merely untidy.
steps.because: storage has to be purchased rather than arriving with the shop (purchasedStorage)

steps.do: Read the upgrade figure as the next step rather than as where you already are.
steps.because: the upgrade level and its cost are tracked apart from the current level (upgradeCosts)

steps.do: Check what you have already bought instead of paying for it twice.
steps.because: the game marks purchases you have already made (PurchasedLicenseIndicator)

steps.do: Spend on growth before you spend on how the shop looks.
steps.because: the shop's level is tracked separately from its appearance (StoreLevelManager)

commonMistakes: Buying decoration while the back room is overflowing.
Assuming storage grows by itself as the shop levels up.
Buying a licence that is already marked as bought.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
